# Bloodborne Research Commons

This is a public, evidence-scoped research index. Choose a task at [START_HERE](START_HERE.md); read [AGENTS](AGENTS.md), the linked dossier/claim and its frontier. No dossier establishes game, native-runtime or GPU results.
